source: md/1_PRD.md FR-28 (P0, PS A, line 206: 'Return/revert to prior stage or institution; reason code + free text mandatory') and the §11 metrics (line 297: 'rejections and returns by reason code' — the reason codes are persisted on the transition row, so that metric is computed from structured data and never from free-text guesswork).
note: PLACEHOLDER VOCABULARY — the PRD mandates a reason code on return/revert but never enumerates the codes, and §19 has no vocabulary open question to answer. The list below is therefore a clearly-labelled placeholder (the same pattern as the 3.3 placeholder day counts): AICTE must confirm the official reason-code list before it is treated as anything but Unverified. Validation rejects unknown codes: an officer cannot invent a code at the keyboard, and this repo does not invent an APH clause at the desk. The free text stays separately mandatory — the code says WHAT KIND of reason, the text says WHAT EXACTLY (FR-28: 'reason code + free text mandatory', both parts).
applies_to_note: 'return' covers the requires_reason workflow actions (return_for_clarification on the routes that define it); 'revert' covers undoing a step. A code may apply to one or both kinds; validation scopes it accordingly.
required_for_actions_note: FR-28 mandates a code + free text on RETURN/revert only — 'reject' also carries a mandatory free-text reason (route config requires_reason) but the PRD does not ask for a code on it, so it is deliberately not listed here. Each listed action must exist in workflow_routes.json with requires_reason true (a cross-config test enforces this); adding or removing a return type is a config edit, not a code change.
